baseline: B_std^Weil6; standard exact exterior algebra, Hermitian arithmetic and derived deformation theory

operations.name: K-linear rational basis change / polarization similitude
operations.hypothesis: Hprime = c conjugate(M)^t H M with M invertible over K, c positive rational
operations.law: delta(Hprime)=delta(H), since c^6 N(det M)=N(c^3 det M)

operations.name: K-compatible polarized isogeny
operations.hypothesis: pullback polarization is a positive rational multiple; automatic for any polarization on the very-general NS-rank-1 target, after transporting the K structure
operations.law: Same determinant law on rational homology

operations.name: unitary Hecke chain
operations.hypothesis: Each step belongs to the frozen GU(H) similitude datum
operations.law: Norm factors compose to a norm, including arbitrary finite chain length

operations.name: duality
operations.hypothesis: Dual K-Hermitian realization, up to compatible rational similitude
operations.law: delta maps to delta^-1=delta; q^2=N(q). det Hdual=-1/3

operations.name: deformation in the fixed polarized K component
operations.hypothesis: Rational K-lattice and polarization local system fixed

operations.name: unrestricted Fourier-Mukai equivalence or an arbitrary algebraic correspondence

block.missing_object: An actual algebraic kernel/correspondence plus a proof of its action on the target Weil carrier
block.necessity: A Mukai/cohomological transform is not automatically a K-linear polarized H^1 similitude.
block.unblock_condition: Supply the kernel and exact action; either establish the preceding hypotheses or directly verify nonzero exceptional cycle transport without assuming a change of discriminant.

universal_proof: Multiplicativity of the Hermitian determinant proves the law for every allowed M,c; the 9 exact examples are controls, not a replacement for the universal proof.
norm_parity_proof: Clear denominators in a^2+b^2. If 3 divides A^2+B^2, reduction modulo 3 forces 3|A and 3|B. Factor out their maximal common power of 3. The remaining sum is nonzero mod 3, so its valuation is 0. Subtracting twice the denominator valuation leaves an even integer.

generalization_audit.source: RSC26 original-preprint indexed sections 3.1 and 5.1; full page unavailable
generalization_audit.torsion_counterexample: (3)=3 O_K, so A[(3)]=A[3] has 3^12=531441 points and A/A[3] is isomorphic to A, not a discriminant-shifting degree-9 quotient.
generalization_audit.scope: Refutes these displayed intermediate claims, not a complete review of the entire preprint.

attribution: Exact restricted classical no-go; not an obstruction to arbitrary algebraic-cycle existence.
